sourceOptions.title: Per-source options
sourceOptions.description: Options keyed by source id, e.g. {"fda_ema_recalls": {"subSources": ["fda"]}}. Each source validates its own slice and rejects unknown keys. Put credentials in the secret fields below, not here.

deltaMode.title: Delta mode
deltaMode.description: onlyChanged = new and changed records (default). onlyNew = new records only. all = every record, unchanged ones included.

stateNamespace.title: Delta memory namespace
stateNamespace.description: Keeps delta memory separate between Tasks (different watchlists, filters or delta modes would otherwise consume each other's "new" records). Leave empty to use one namespace per Task, or "default" for ad-hoc runs. 1-40 characters: a-z, 0-9, "-".

maxItemsPerSource.title: Max records per source
maxItemsPerSource.description: Upper bound on records taken from each source in one run.

watchlistNames.title: Watchlist keywords
watchlistNames.description: Case-insensitive substrings matched against each record's names. Entries shorter than 2 characters, blank or punctuation-only entries are ignored. With no valid keyword nothing matches and the watchlist-hit event is never charged.

maxWatchlistHitsPerRun.title: Max billable watchlist hits per run
maxWatchlistHitsPerRun.description: Hard ceiling on watchlist-hit events charged in one run.

maxWatchlistSpendUsd.title: Max watchlist-hit spend per run (USD)
maxWatchlistSpendUsd.description: Hard ceiling on USD charged for watchlist-hit in one run.

usptoOdpApiKey.title: USPTO Open Data Portal API key
usptoOdpApiKey.description: Bring-your-own credential for uspto_ptab. Stored encrypted by Apify and never logged.

epoOpsConsumerKey.title: EPO OPS consumer key
epoOpsConsumerKey.description: Bring-your-own credential for epo_opposition. Stored encrypted by Apify and never logged.

epoOpsConsumerSecret.title: EPO OPS consumer secret
epoOpsConsumerSecret.description: Bring-your-own credential for epo_opposition. Stored encrypted by Apify and never logged.

fdaApiKey.title: openFDA API key (optional)
